notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 is Live!
notes.notes:
Patch v1.4.0 is live!

Changed:
[list]
[*] Settings for the Self Care Minigame Highlight Tiles - changed from a toggle to a dropdown with 3 options - All (Easy), Latest (Normal), and None (Hard). "All (Easy)" will now highlight the only tiles possible for all the selected tiles and will stay highlighted even if you run into an intrusive thought. "Latest (Normal)" is the same as when the old setting used to be checked - meaning it only highlights the tiles from the last one you selected. "None (Hard)" is the same as when the old setting used to be unchecked - meaning it never highlights based on what you select. Hope this new setting helps to make the self care minigame a bit easier!
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
[*] UI fixes (text overflow, text alignment)
[*] Fixed memories board sometimes not showing the exclamation point when there is an epilogue to view
[/list]

Reminder that you can submit a bug report through Google forms: [url=https://forms.gle/nz2RoMXXumem8JNi9]https://forms.gle/nz2RoMXXumem8JNi9[/url] or you can also email me directly at info@janbehgames.com Thanks!

notes.title: Ghostie Songs and Demo Update
notes.notes:
One of the new features we’ve added in Love, Ghostie is the ability to sing to your residents!

We were inspired by Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time where you can play different songs that have different effects!

Here is the “happy song”:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/3902d19fbca7e41c92bb58506de83652daf4000b.gif[/img]

Here’s a link to the original video on Twitter where you can hear it with sound: [url=https://twitter.com/janbehchanbeh/status/1772714975485735338]https://twitter.com/janbehchanbeh/status/1772714975485735338[/url]

This was so fun to design and our composer, Sam, did an amazing job coming up with 4 very different songs with only 4 notes!

In other news, we’ve finished the ending of Love, Ghostie and added New Game+. It’s all coming together and it’s a mix of feeling excited, scared, and relieved that we’re getting closer to the finish line!

As a heads up, I’ll be taking down the demo starting early next week! But don’t worry, we’ll be back with an updated demo soon. It’ll (most likely) feature all the characters available and will allow you to try out some of the new upgrades!

Thanks so much for your patience and for reading!

- Jennifer
